NHLA Board takes official position on hardwood log exports
November 12, 2026 | 1:05 pm CST
NHLA Board takes official position on hardwood log exports
MEMPHIS — Following extensive discussion and a survey of voting members, the NHLA Board of Directors has adopted an official position on hardwood log exports.

"The decision marks an important step toward addressing concerns about the movement of North American hardwood resources and the future of the domestic hardwood lumber industry," the association said in its position statement. "While members hold differing views, the survey revealed important areas of common ground that helped guide the Board's decision."
The Board approved the following official statement:
The NHLA opposes the unrestricted export of US hardwood logs.

The NHLA recognizes the immediate need to curtail the flow of our natural resource to countries that use predatory purchasing practices and do not support the North American hardwood lumber industry, which is vital to the United States and Canada.

The NHLA has formed the Hardwood Export Log Policy Task Force whose goal is to partner with our allied associations to lead the industry to help determine next steps and actions to protect our North American hardwood lumber industry and natural resource.

What's Next?
The Hardwood Export Log Policy (HELP) Task Force will explore potential actions and present its recommendations at the Spring NHLA Board meeting. This is an opportunity to turn a shared industry concern into a coordinated effort and establish a path forward.
